title: Emrys and the Bridge
author: Ulyana Blackwood
blurb: Ulyana Yarrow, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
